description: The concepts a known course teaches, for a state. Use it first when the student names a class they took.

configuration.query: FROM courses | WHERE TO_LOWER(state) == TO_LOWER(?state) AND TO_LOWER(course) == TO_LOWER(?course) | KEEP course, state, teaches

state.description: The US state, for example Utah.

course.description: The course name as the student wrote it, for example Exploring Computer Science.
